t: The Fortress Trade 12" Medium Pile Roller Sleeve is a durable decorating tool designed for efficient paint application across various surfaces. Featuring a high-quality microfibre mix, this roller sleeve provides excellent paint load and smooth release, significantly reducing splatter for a cleaner finish. Its closed fibres ensure a smooth and even texture, making it ideal for trade professionals tackling larger projects such as walls and ceilings in commercial or domestic properties. The thermobonded fabric construction ensures minimal lint loss, delivering a professional result every time with multi-purpose paints.
